rag.text:
Test: TC-4012 — Global - Widget - WBS - Displaying WBS Widget for newly created Jira issue
Priority: Medium | Status: In Review | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-181 Global - Widget - WBS

Description:
This TC check if WBS Widget is correctly loaded after the Clear Cache action, for the newly created task by Jira without entering BP/BG application.

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Gantt module of the boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-4012 Widget- WBS - Displaying WBS Widget for newly created Jira issue
   Expected: Gantt module is correctly loaded with project and one issue under it:
- Task 1
2. Click on the key of taskName
   Data: taskName: Task 1
   Expected: Jira issue view is opened in new tab
3. Go back to the first tab and Navigate to the App Configuration > Advanced and perform Clear Cache (For Atlassian Cloud - perform Fix Integrity Checker errors)
   Expected: Clear Cache / Fix Integrity Checker errors is performed successfully
4. Go back to the second tab with Jira issue view and Navigate to the Backlog of the project
   Expected: Backlog with one Jira issue: Task 1 is loaded.
5. Create issue with issueName and navigate to the Issue view of it
   Data: issueName: Task 2
   Expected: Task is created successfully and Jira issue view is loaded
6. After 10 seconds refresh the page
Turn on WBS Widget if needed (for Cloud expand Apps button)
   Expected: WBS Widget is loaded and Task 2 is visible in the structure under Project issue.
